modern: You will soon die, and you are not yet simple, nor free from disturbance, nor free from suspicion of being hurt by external things, nor kindly disposed towards all; nor do you yet place wisdom only in acting justly.
original: Thou wilt soon die, and thou art not yet simple, nor free from perturbations, nor without suspicion of being hurt by external things, nor kindly disposed towards all; nor dost thou yet place wisdom only in acting justly.
